name: Epipolar Sampling with 1D Min/Max Binary Tree Optimization
definition: A technique to accelerate inscattering integral calculation for light shafts by casting rays through an epipolar plane (defined by camera and light direction) and using 1D min/max binary trees built on shadow map slices to skip shadowed or lit regions during ray marching.
summary: Epipolar Sampling with 1D Min/Max Binary Tree Optimization accelerates volumetric light shafts by using binary trees to skip large lit or shadowed regions during ray marching.
